critical_code_review_comments: ShareCard canNative checks only that navigator.canShare/share exist. It should call navigator.canShare({files:[file]}), otherwise desktop Chrome/Edge may show 'Share image' and then fail with the 'cancelled or unavailable' note.
BonusDialog replay calls audio.current.play() without .catch, so a playback rejection (e.g., decode failure) becomes an unhandled promise rejection.

The puzzle answers are hashed, but 'Access Point', 'whisper' and the riddle hints appear in plain text in the JS bundle (caption, share-card text, success text). This is acceptable for an easter egg; just be aware.
easter-egg-answer shows the raw guess uppercased (for example '  FIND THE WHISPER ' or 'FINDTHEWHISPER'). Consider showing a canonical 'FIND THE WHISPER' after solving.
The window.open(..., 'noopener') LinkedIn share works. LinkedIn redirects logged-out users to login, which is expected.
